description: This file defines the TemplateVariable class which extends TempNameExpression and manages template variable names and their compilation within Twig's templating engine.

classes.name: TemplateVariable
classes.description: A class for handling template variable names in Twig, extending TempNameExpression to include custom getName and compile methods.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the template variable, generating a new name if not already set.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the variable reference for output in the rendered template, handling special case '_self'.
